card.name: Infection testing and culture wording
card.fires_on: Small words or punctuation just before an infection test or culture term, such as the comma after 'When feasible', 'repeating' before 'infectious workup', or 'positive' before 'culture'. Seen in drug-label text on fungal, viral and bacterial infection workup.

modes.label: Comma after a lead-in
modes.description: The comma after 'When feasible' leads into a decision about empiric antifungal treatment after testing.
modes.example: When feasible<<,>> the decision to administer empiric antif

modes.label: Word before a test or culture
modes.description: A word such as 'repeating', 'positive', 'for' or 'or' sits right before a test, culture or pathogen term.
modes.example: consider<< repeating>> infectious workup to exclude alternative eti
